description: `useDeferredValue(value, initialValue?)` returns a copy of `value` that lags behind during urgent renders and catches up in an interruptible background render.
UI rendered from the previous deferred value. Detect it with `value !== deferredValue` and dim it or set `aria-busy`.
The low-priority render where the deferred value updates. It can be interrupted by new input and does not show Suspense fallbacks for visible content.
Waits a fixed time before acting. Reduces calls but is not interruptible; complementary to deferred values.
